records.title: FinCEN issues landmark virtual-currency guidance
records.summary: FinCEN issued guidance distinguishing virtual-currency users from administrators and exchangers and applying money-transmitter rules to qualifying businesses.
records.significance: It became a foundational US federal compliance framework for cryptocurrency businesses.

records.title: Cyprus banking crisis amplifies Bitcoin safe-haven narrative
records.summary: Bitcoin rose sharply during the Cyprus banking crisis while contemporary coverage linked interest in Bitcoin to fears over deposit losses and capital controls.
records.significance: The episode helped establish Bitcoin's narrative as money outside the conventional banking system, although it should not be treated as proof that Cyprus alone caused the rally.

sources.title: CNN Money — Bitcoin prices surge post-Cyprus bailout

records.title: Bitcoin trades above $100 for the first time
records.summary: Bitcoin crossed the $100 level during its first major 2013 speculative surge.
records.significance: Three-digit Bitcoin moved the asset from hobbyist curiosity toward a much broader financial story.

records.title: SEC charges Bitcoin Savings & Trust operator over Ponzi scheme
records.summary: The SEC charged Trendon Shavers and Bitcoin Savings & Trust with operating a Bitcoin-denominated Ponzi scheme.
records.significance: It was an early demonstration that conventional securities and fraud laws would be applied to Bitcoin-denominated investment schemes.

sources.title: SEC — Charges Trendon Shavers / Bitcoin Savings & Trust

records.title: Mastercoin conducts an early Bitcoin-layer token sale
records.summary: Mastercoin used an Exodus Address fundraiser during August 2013: contributors sent BTC and received protocol-layer Mastercoins.
records.significance: The sale is one of the clearest ancestors of the ICO model and an early attempt to build programmable assets on Bitcoin.

sources.title: Omni Foundation — Brief History of Mastercoin

records.title: Silk Road is seized and Ross Ulbricht arrested
records.summary: Federal agents arrested Ross Ulbricht in a San Francisco library and seized Silk Road infrastructure.
records.significance: The takedown became a landmark test of Bitcoin-linked law enforcement, darknet investigation, digital forensics and asset seizure.

records.title: World's first publicly accessible Bitcoin ATM opens in Vancouver
records.summary: A Robocoin kiosk went live at Waves Coffee House in Vancouver, allowing customers to exchange cash and Bitcoin.
records.significance: The machine made Bitcoin conversion a physical walk-up consumer experience.

sources.title: CityNews Vancouver — world's first Bitcoin ATM

records.title: US Senate holds major virtual-currency hearing
records.summary: The Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee held a hearing titled Beyond Silk Road: Potential Risks, Threats, and Promises of Virtual Currencies.
records.significance: It marked a shift from treating Bitcoin solely as a criminal curiosity toward formal consideration of both risks and legitimate uses.

sources.title: US Senate HSGAC — Beyond Silk Road hearing

records.title: Bitcoin trades above $1,000 for the first time
records.summary: Bitcoin crossed $1,000 on Mt. Gox during the late-2013 rally.
records.significance: The four-digit milestone capped Bitcoin's first truly global speculative boom.

records.title: James Howells' lost Bitcoin hard-drive story becomes public
records.summary: UK media reported that James Howells had discarded a hard drive containing keys to roughly 7,500 BTC and believed it was buried in a Newport landfill.
records.significance: It became crypto's archetypal lost-keys story and a vivid illustration of irreversible self-custody.

sources.title: The Guardian — missing hard drive in Newport landfill

records.title: Ethereum whitepaper is introduced
records.summary: Ethereum's official history dates Vitalik Buterin's introductory whitepaper to 27 November 2013.
records.significance: The paper proposed a general-purpose blockchain for smart contracts, extending the blockchain idea far beyond money.

records.title: China restricts financial institutions from Bitcoin business
records.summary: Chinese authorities said Bitcoin was a virtual commodity rather than legal currency and barred financial and payment institutions from Bitcoin-related business.
records.significance: It was the first major China regulatory shock in crypto markets and began a recurring policy theme lasting years.

records.title: Dogecoin launches
records.summary: Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer launched Dogecoin around the Doge internet meme.
records.significance: Dogecoin fused cryptocurrency with meme culture, tipping and community fundraising and became the ancestor of the modern meme-coin category.

records.title: HODL is born
records.summary: BitcoinTalk user GameKyuubi titled a post 'I AM HODLING,' a misspelling of holding that immediately became community slang.
records.significance: HODL became one of crypto's most enduring memes and a shorthand for refusing to sell through volatility.
